violence.rationale: Dialogue describes numerous unexplained deaths, contaminated bodies, autopsies, bones picked clean and dramatic threats (self-destruct bomb). These are realistic, frightening deaths and peril but not graphic gore in subtitles—rated moderate.
evidence: Buzzards only come when something's dead.
Five quarts of blood turned to powder!
Major! Take a look at that, sir. We just found this, General. It's a human bone. Arm, I think.

sex.rationale: Very mild romantic/sexual references in dialogue (reassuring arms, bordello remark) but no explicit sexual activity or nudity—rated mild.
evidence: I'll be safe as in your arms.
Reminds me of my years in a bordello.

language.rationale: Frequent mild profanity and exclamations ("damn", "God's sakes") and strong language but no f-word or slurs—rated mild.
evidence: Damn it, Comroe, of course we're certain.
Damn it, get this call through!

substances.rationale: Dialogue includes references to Sterno drinking and its physiological effects and characters smoking—substance use referenced and implicated in plot, more than incidental background—rated moderate.
evidence: In Piedmont, Jackson was crocked on Sterno.
I'd like a cigarette right now.
